The boat hire jetty has moved to the west shore, near the café
The old boathouse is now a restaurant with a terrace over the water

tasks.title: How biogas is produced from waste
tasks.prompt: The diagram shows how biogas, a renewable fuel, is produced from farm and food waste.

figures.alt: A cycle of seven stages: waste is collected, shredded, broken down by bacteria in a digester, and the gas is cleaned and used for energy, while the leftover material fertilises crops.

facts.title: How biogas is produced from waste

stages.text: Crops are grown and farm animals are raised.
Animal manure and food waste are collected.
The waste is shredded and mixed with water.
In a sealed digester tank, bacteria break the waste down without oxygen for three to four weeks.
The biogas (mostly methane) is collected and cleaned.
The gas is used to generate electricity, heat buildings or fuel vehicles.
The leftover material (digestate) is spread on fields as fertiliser, helping new crops to grow.
